column1: # apricorn pin table: ARM9 static main (RAM image after crt0 decompression)
# Columns (tab-separated): name, mode, address, size, prologue-sha1, discovered-by
#   prologue-sha1: SHA-1 over the first min(16, size) bytes at the address
#     (arm/thumb pins always use 16 bytes; a hash of zero bytes marks a .bss
#     pin whose address lies beyond the image end — the loader zeroes it).
#   discovered-by: how the pin was located (literal-pool scan of a known
#     constant, or a cross-reference in pret's labeled lib/asm/nitro.s).
# The math_util functions were found by scanning for the LCG multiplier
# 0x41C64E6D / MT multiplier 0x6C078965 / tempering and XOR constants and
# decoding the surrounding Thumb code; the SDK MATH_* functions carry real
# addresses in pret's `lib/asm/nitro.s` and were matched by prologue.
